label: TP
reason: Alert 1 is TP because the insecure randomness is used to generate a session ID/remember-me token (rememberMeKey) which is stored in a cookie and used for authentication purposes. Alert 2 is TP because the user-provided value from the cookie (param) flows directly into the HTTP response without proper encoding, creating a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness source (java.util.Random.nextFloat()) used to generate rememberMeKey, which is then stored in a cookie for session management
User-provided value from cookie flows into HTTP response without encoding, creating XSS vulnerability
